tasks.short: Calculate shipment weight, volume and cost.

steps.what: Check goods measurements, packaging, origin, destination and the applicable carrier tariff
inputs: shipper packing list and measurement evidence

steps.what: Enter and check units, quantities, dimensions, measured weights and tariff references
Calculate total volume, chargeable weight and tariff-based shipment cost
outputs: calculated shipment totals with tariff references

steps.what: Resolve exceptional charges and approve the final calculation record
inputs: calculated shipment totals with tariff references

steps.what: Commit the approved calculation record to the shipment

tasks.design: Use the native tariff calculator in {OPS_SYSTEM} for dimensional arithmetic, chargeable-weight rules and explicit tariff charges. The forwarder checks and captures actual measurements and tariff versions at full time, resolves exceptions, then approves the complete calculation before its separate record commit. No quotation is automatically sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unclear measurement units and tariff exceptions defeat a simple multiplication.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shipment calculators can apply explicit unit and tariff rules to checked fields.
tasks.still_hard: Missing measurements and nonstandard surcharges require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge an implausible weight or an inapplicable charge before it reaches the quotation.
tasks.altitude: Reliable arithmetic with retained measurement and charge judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: freight systems can calculate volume and tariff charges from explicit quantities, dimensions and weight rules.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Measure actual manual arithmetic and posting; existing native calculations earn no new saving.

Shipper produces packing list and measurements; carrier supplies current tariff. s1 verifies evidence and missing information; s2 forwarder captures quantity, length, width, height, dimension_unit, measured_weight, weight_unit, origin, destination, service, tariff_version and charge conditions at full time. No automatic document extraction is assumed.
s3 uses only explicit carrier formulas, rounding, minimums and checked charges. Missing terms fall back to manual s4 resolution, never inferred charges. Native functionality precedes code.

s4 writes/checks final totals, exceptions and source references. a1 binds that complete record and shipment identifier; edits revoke approval. Shipment quotation or carrier booking is not performed by this calculation action.
research_questions: Which calculations are still manual after using the current forwarding systems native tariff module?

incremental.description: Check tariff versions, unit mappings and formula exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 30 arithmetic and 5 posting hours minus 2 upkeep = 33. Low halves arithmetic benefit and keeps posting manual: 15 minus 2 = 13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange destination delivery or storage of goods.

steps.what: Clarify destination delivery, access, timing and storage requirements with the consignee
Capture destination constraints and verify available supplier offers
inputs: actual delivery or warehouse supplier offers
outputs: checked destination booking fields and offers

steps.what: Display compatible delivery or storage offers with their explicit prices and constraints
inputs: checked destination booking fields and offers

steps.what: Select service and prepare and approve the complete destination booking
inputs: checked destination booking fields and offers

steps.what: Send the approved destination delivery or storage booking to the selected supplier
Verify actual supplier acceptance and resolve destination booking discrepancies
Write and approve the actual booking-status record
Commit the approved actual destination booking record
Prepare and approve consignee instructions from the verified booking status
Send approved destination instructions to the consignee

tasks.design: Use a native forwarding comparison in {OPS_SYSTEM} to filter checked supplier offers against explicit destination constraints. Keep requirements capture, service choice and supplier acceptance checks human. The complete booking is approved before submission; actual acceptance precedes a separately approved status record and consignee message. No unconfirmed warehouse space is called reserved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Destination access and actual supplier capacity are not established by a requested slot.
tasks.enabler_now: Native offer views and exact booking transfers can reduce copying between checked records.
tasks.still_hard: Special handling, access failures and changed acceptance require coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a destination arrangement the consignee and supplier can actually execute.
tasks.altitude: Less offer comparison and transfer work; retained destination judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forwarding systems can compare recorded service offers and transfer an approved booking through a supported supplier interface.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Check actual manual offer comparison and transfers; existing native bookings earn no new saving.

Consignee supplies address, delivery window, access limits and storage needs in s1. Agent captures/checks these plus shipment dimensions, handling needs, offer_id, price, expiry and available slots in s2 at full time. Supplier produces actual offers; missing offers require existing human contact rather than fabricated capacity.

s4 writes/checks the final supplier, service, goods, dates, price, terms and destination within existing authority. a1 binds that completed booking. Any changed offer requires a revised final approval.

Supplier response is a new actual source in s6; agent captures its actual reference/status in s7 at full time. Pending stays pending. a2 binds that record; s9 independently writes/checks final consignee instructions before a3. Native tools precede code; unsupported interfaces stay manual.
research_questions: Which destination offers can the native forwarding system compare without new supplier data entry?

incremental.description: Check supplier offer fields and booking interface changes

approvals.approved_version: s4 final destination booking and supplier
s9 final consignee instructions and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 10 comparison, 10 booking-send, 3 record and 2 instruction-send hours minus 1.5 upkeep = 23.5. Low halves comparison benefit and keeps all actions manual: 5 minus 1.5 = 3.5.

tasks.short: Arrange multimodal transport with lower environmental impact.

steps.what: Confirm shipment needs and obtain actual feasible rail, sea, air or road offers
Capture route legs, shipment load, service constraints and environmental calculation assumptions
Calculate comparable route emissions and show price, transit time and method limitations
Choose a feasible lower-impact route and approve the complete transport booking
Submit the approved transport booking to the selected carrier
Check actual carrier acceptance and resolve service or route changes
Write and approve actual booking status and environmental estimate limitations
Commit the approved actual multimodal shipment record
Prepare and approve the actual service confirmation for the shipper
Send the approved actual multimodal service confirmation

tasks.design: Use an existing deterministic transport-emissions calculator, represented by {OTHER}, alongside {OPS_SYSTEM} to compare actual feasible offers under one declared method. Keep input verification, route choice and booking approval human. Submit the final booking separately, inspect actual carrier acceptance, then approve and commit the actual-status record and separately approve/send the shipper confirmation. A calculated estimate is not a measured emissions reduction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different route assumptions make environmental comparisons misleading.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calculators can apply a consistent declared method across captured route legs.
tasks.still_hard: Available capacity, handling limits, transit reliability and methodological gaps require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an executable route while explaining cost, timing and uncertainty honestly.
tasks.altitude: Comparable environmental estimates support a human transport commitment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic freight-emissions calculators can estimate route impacts from explicit mode, route, load and methodology inputs.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify current manual comparison and booking actions; current calculator outputs and carrier runtime create no new labour saving. Environmental improvement itself is unmeasured here.

Shipper produces goods, dimensions, weight and required dates; carrier produces actual route legs, services, availability and price. s1/s2 agent captures/checks mode, origin/destination by leg, distance basis, load quantity, equipment, handling needs, service window, price and method/version at full time. Existing approved calculator supplies documented factors/defaults, not an invented carrier fuel measurement. Unknown actual characteristics remain labelled estimates; absent comparable inputs use manual evaluation with no s3 saving.

s4 writes/checks the complete priced route booking within existing authority. This task covers one contracted multimodal carrier offer; separately contracted legs require separate final booking approvals and sends with actual effort. a1 binds only the complete reviewed booking. Route changes return to review rather than silently substituting a carrier.

Actual carrier confirmation arrives after s5; s6/s7 capture/check its reference, accepted legs and status at full time. s9 writes/checks a shipper message using actual status and qualified estimates before a3. Native calculator/export and booking controls precede code; no AI chooses a mode or claims a guaranteed reduction.
research_questions: Can the existing calculator compare feasible carrier offers under one documented scope without additional uncounted data capture?

incremental.description: Maintain route mappings and verify environmental method versions

approvals.approved_version: s4 final priced multimodal booking and carrier
s7 final actual booking-status record and qualified estimate
s9 final shipper confirmation and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 comparison, 8 booking-send, 2 record and 1 confirmation-send hours minus 2 upkeep = 24. Low halves comparison benefit and keeps all sends/commits manual: 7.5 minus 2 = 5.5.

tasks.short: Determine efficient and cost-effective methods for moving goods.

steps.what: Establish cargo handling constraints, deadlines and the customers cost/service priorities
Record decision requirements and verify current feasible route and rate offers
inputs: current carrier route and rate offers

steps.what: Compare total stated charges, transit times and explicit feasibility constraints
Evaluate operational risks and select the efficient cost-effective transport method
outputs: human transport method decision and rationale

steps.what: Write and approve the final transport method recommendation
inputs: human transport method decision and rationale

steps.what: Save the approved final transport recommendation
Send the approved final transport recommendation to the customer

tasks.design: Configure a native route/rate comparison in {OPS_SYSTEM} using checked actual offers and explicit shipment constraints. It totals stated charges and filters explicit constraints; the forwarder retains risk interpretation, choice and recommendation writing. Save and customer send are separate actions after the full final recommendation exists. Determining a method does not silently book capacity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cheapest nominal rate may omit charges or fail the actual service requirement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native route/rate views can compare checked offers and transparent arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Reliability, unusual cargo and tradeoffs beyond explicit fields require judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a feasible service is preferable to an apparently cheap but unsuitable option.
tasks.altitude: Less comparison arithmetic with retained transport choice and communication.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: forwarding software can compare recorded route rates and service constraints without making the final operational choice.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Observe actual manual comparison and recommendation transfers; current native comparisons earn no new saving.

Customer produces cargo, dates and cost/service preferences in s1. Carriers produce offers. Agent records/checks origin, destination, weight, dimensions, handling needs, deadline, mode, transit_time, validity, capacity_statement and each stated charge/currency in s2 at full time. s3 does not infer missing charges, live capacity or a reliability score. Missing facts require retained manual investigation.

s4 decides the method; s5 writes/checks final rationale, limitations, validity and intended customer at full time. Native calculation/template controls are checked first; substantive writing is unchanged.

a1 binds the complete final recommendation and internal shipment reference; a2 independently binds that same final content and customer recipient. Any edit revokes both. No carrier booking or binding customer order is performed.
research_questions: Which cross-offer comparisons remain manual once existing forwarding software shows all checked charges?

incremental.description: Check rate mappings, validity and comparison fields

approvals.approved_version: s5 final recommendation and shipment reference
s5 final recommendation and customer recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 20 comparison, 3 save and 2 send hours minus 1.5 upkeep = 23.5. Low halves comparison benefit and keeps transfers manual: 10 minus 1.5 = 8.5.

role.altitude: Use checked shipment and service facts for transparent calculations and human transport decisions.
reach: Help shipment teams distinguish estimates, approved bookings and actual carrier acceptances.
role.ambitious_version: A forwarder who chooses feasible transport, explains costs and environmental uncertainty, and maintains an accurate record of actual supplier commitments.
